kemz.lead: A new factory website: from an urgent brief and design concept to the equipment catalog, CMS, forms, and launch.
kemz.title: Making complex manufacturing clear
kemz.intro: For KEMZ, I built a complete digital tool: a distinctive website, product catalog, clear inquiry paths, and content management.
kemz.caption: Actual screen of the updated KEMZ website
kemz.contextTitle: The website needed to solve problems, not create them
kemz.contextText: The brief called for a fast solution: a modern site where visitors could find equipment and send a technical inquiry. According to the client, the old forms let spam through to their inbox. The visitor journey and request handling needed a rethink.
kemz.scope1Text: I reorganized navigation around products, manufacturing, and inquiries. The visual language conveys the scale of the factory while keeping technical content legible.
kemz.scope2Text: I built pages for product areas, production, documents, and news. Content connects to a CMS so the team can update the site without code changes.
kemz.scope3Text: I rebuilt the technical inquiry flow, added validation, and protected forms from spam. Requests reach the team in a usable format.
kemz.scope4Text: I optimized loading and Core Web Vitals, then prepared semantic structure and metadata for search.
kemz.screenTitle: From the opening screen to an actual inquiry
kemz.screenText: Visitors can immediately see what the factory makes. The next step is a catalog organized by application, followed by an inquiry form with technical parameters.
kemz.proofNote: The website is faster, while content and inquiries are easier for the team to manage.
kemz.reviewDraftText: “Thank you for the fast turnaround. The new site helps us present our equipment and receive more precise customer inquiries.”
kemz.detailsText: The home page explains the factory's expertise. The catalog helps find equipment, and the technical inquiry captures the project requirements.
kemz.resultText: In a mobile PageSpeed Insights test, the site scored 95 for performance. The other scores and loading metrics come from the September 23, 2026 report.
kemz.psiSource: PageSpeed Insights · aokemz.ru · mobile · lab data
kemz.outcomeTitle: One partner, the full project journey
kemz.outcomeText: The site brings together the company story, catalog, news, documents, and technical inquiries. Design, development, content, and launch preparation form one process.
kemz.discuss: Need a site with this level of depth?
